scripts.db: docker compose -f provider/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait && docker compose -f consumer/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait
scripts.db:down: docker compose -f provider/docker-compose.yml down && docker compose -f consumer/docker-compose.yml down
scripts.dev: npm run db && concurrently -k -n provider-api,provider-web,consumer-api,consumer-web -c blue,cyan,green,magenta npm:dev:provider-api npm:dev:provider-web npm:dev:consumer-api npm:dev:consumer-web
scripts.dev:provider: docker compose -f provider/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait && concurrently -k -n provider-api,provider-web -c blue,cyan npm:dev:provider-api npm:dev:provider-web
scripts.dev:consumer: docker compose -f consumer/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait && concurrently -k -n consumer-api,consumer-web -c green,magenta npm:dev:consumer-api npm:dev:consumer-web
